findings.title: A null identity entry, which in ARM PATCH means unassign, is turned into `{}`, which assigns it.
findings.body: For an entry like `"<uami-id>": null`, `clean_null_values(None) or {}` returns `{}`. In ARM PATCH semantics, a `userAssignedIdentities` entry set to `null` removes that identity from the resource, and `{}` assigns or keeps it. So a manifest that tries to detach an identity now sends a body that keeps or attaches it. Before this change the entry was dropped, so nothing happened; now the request does the opposite of what the user wrote. Keep explicit nulls as nulls: `{k: None if v is None else (clean_null_values(v) or {}) for k, v in value.items()}`. The outer filter still keeps the map because it is a non-empty dict. I could not check whether this PATCH path goes on to merge with the existing identity block.
